content: Namwa Gapomanena Pii Kamba Laa Narama Ingilyamo
Wambu peparae gapomanena lowa minyuo kararami ingilyamo. Gapomane yulu doko mee epa naya. Anatumi nakama karena lapala gapomane inginyi pyambungi.
Mendeme gapomane nembalana lara ramo doko Anatunya lowa pii kamba larasa pira. Dopa piraminyi wambu dupwa keta kote doko range keta nyinyi pisarasa pira.

Pundu nyuo koo pingi wambumi iki gapomane kando pakarami. Yulu keyange pingi wambu dupwame gapomane pakaraminde daa. Emba gapomane paka nalana suu pyare ramo doko keyange dupwa anjuku lao koto nyuo pyuo karare. Dopa pyuo karare ramo dokopa gapomaneme emba lakandara.

Gapomane doko Anatunya kendemande ingyuo nakama kapa serami dokona yulu pyakalyamo. Yulu koo piri ramo dokopa gapomane kinyi pakare. Dokopa baame male lao nakama randa jerande daa. Angingyuo randa jera porai doko baa keta silyamo. Baa Anatunya kendemande ingyuo dokome yulu koo pingi dupwa keta Anatunya imbu singi doko gapomane keta nakama randa mainya epenge.

Renge dokona lao nakama gapomanena pii minyarami ingilyamo. Anatunya imbu singi nyeramano lapala gapomane yulu minyaraminde daa. Nakamana monana suu pingimi opetae langyuo karamo dokona sepala minyuo kararami.
Takisi kana doko renge dokona lao maiyuo karaminyi. Gapomane baa yulu dopale dokona mondo lao pingi doko Anatu pyakamilyasa pingi.

Dokona lao takisi kana doko kapa pyalapape. Nakama rangena lao takisi pyao dee takisi kana kata wakale mendena kee lara ramo dokona pyaoko pipape. Dopa pyuo gapomane dokonape dee yulu wakale mendenape piyaminyi kandeyami kande, dolapona nakamame kingi ketae pyambuo lakando kararami ingilyamo.
Nakama Yango Sukusa Yulu Pyuo Nyisalapape
Bange dupwa pakiki nyuo retakamyuo kara nalapape. Mendali mona retarami doko yano dopale ingyuo nakama keta pakiki sinya. Mendeme yango mona retaramo doko Lowa dokona minyuo kaelyo lao piyasa piya.

Pii lowana pyasi palamo dokona lao dokopa, Kepo pii nalapape. Pyao kumasa nalapape. Waa nyii nalapape. Nyipuli nyipuli suu pyaa nalapape, dopa lao palamo. Dusipape menge lapo opetaepe pyasi palamo. Dupwa peparae lowa pii mendakimi simu pyao minyaro karamo. Doko dopa letamo. Wambu yango dupwa emba range mona nyilini doko suu pyaoko mona reto karape, letamo.
Yango mona retara ramo dokome doko kando koo pinya yakara pira. Yango mona retare ramo dokome Lowa pii peparae minyaresa pira.

Embame yuu gii doko anjokorape lao silini dokome pii lamwa dokona palyuo pyuo karape. Doko lenge rao karalapape lao gii doko epo kaelyamo. Namwa wamba mona maipala Kurisene ingiyama dokopa Koraisana lete wai pyao nyera doko nanesale siya. Doko epapu repetale epo kaelyamo.
Iminjingi doko isa pao kaepyamopa yuu gii angi doko repeta epelyamo. Iminjingi yulu dokona pii namanale. Yanga paupau lenge kaku walakyape dupwame minyuo yanda pirama doko nyuo minyaro karamana.

Namwame biya napalako karele lao kyawa sisingi bolombalo laramo kara napala pamuku yulupi yulu karo petenge dupwa suu pyaope pyakandenge yulupi dee yango palyingipi yulu dupwa yaki nyelapape. Epapu yangelyamo kandanyi nembo karenge dopale ingyuo mondo lao pyuo karamana.
Kamongo Yesu Koraisana yanda pingi bange dupwa nyepala nakamana yanengena nyakamipuli lao suu pingi dokona pii sakami nalapape.
